text:
Asha: FYI from SRE postmortem 0: we had a cascade where fallback->quarantine loops caused unexpected token charges. need a clear decision model + console surface.
Ben: ouch. propose a small canonical decision header: X-Decision: canonical_id=<id>,attempt=<n>,decision={primary|fallback|quarantine},reason=<code>. cheap and deterministic.
Kai: agree on canonical_id. billing can then dedupe reliably. also we should define billing winner rules: default=first_successful_response unless org has 'prefer-primary' flag.
Tanvi: UX: show a compact "Decision" column in the rollout timeline entries: e.g. "primary (95%) | fallback (5%)" and expose an audit link for any override.
Ben: policy question: if quarantine returns a short canned message then primary later produces full answer, who consumes quota? canonical approach: charge once using canonical_id, attribute tokens to served model, but annotate reason.
Asha: we also need per-rollout grace budgets for canaries but with strict cooldowns. suggest: grace_tokens, grace_window_secs, cooldown_secs, and per-org max_grace_per_month. show remaining in UI and export as ledger rows.
Kai: sampling: add adaptive sampling that triggers on "unusual" fallback signals instead of raw rate. e.g. if fallback_reason distribution shifts (timeout -> model_error spike) then capture higher sampling for that route+org for T minutes.
Tanvi: UI control: per-rollout "capture traces" toggle (10m/30m/1h) that requires justification and creates an audit event. also a small pulse animation when active.
billing-bot: finance: please advise on whether grace token consumption should be invoiced as 0 immediately or marked as promo_credit line. Finance pref: ledger entry + zero-dollar line item so exports reconcile easily.
Asha: audit: any change to charge_policy or manual adjustments must create immutable audit entries with actor, action, before, after, justification, and ledger_id if money moved. redact model outputs.
audit-bot: recommended audit schema: event_type, rollout_id, actor, action, before, after, reason_code, ledger_id, ts. keep fields minimal and string-typed.
Ben: implementation note: router already tracks fallback counters. we'll add a lightweight decision_emitter that writes decision tags to metrics and to a small sampling queue. feature-flag it initially.
Kai: cost control: default traces off. adaptive sampler rates: baseline 0.05% -> bump 5% for 10m on anomaly -> decay by 2x each window. also provide org-level opt-out from sampling for privacy-focused customers.
Tanvi: mock: rollout card shows two small chips: "degrade: silent|gentle|loud" and "grace: 3.2k left". clicking chips opens history and audit timeline. operator override button requires justification modal.
Asha: safety: override actions auto-expire after configured ttl and create an audit. require role check and SSO group membership; escalate to multi-approver if outside biz-hours.
Ben: next steps: I'll draft proto for X-Decision header + migration plan; Kai will draft sampler tuning + anomaly detector; Tanvi will mock UI and capture modal; Asha will draft audit/ledger rows and coordinate Finance.
Kai: will open PR with feature flag and minimal metrics emission.
Tanvi: will post Figma link here when ready :mag: .
Asha: schedule: sync Fri 11. Any objections?
Ben: none from infra.
Kai: LGTM.
Tanvi: thumbs up :white_check_mark:
